description: This file contains implementation code for container management within the WPEFramework, including classes and methods for container lifecycle operations such as creation, starting, stopping, and status querying, as well as singleton access patterns and logging initialization.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Implements container administration functions, including container creation and logging, as a singleton.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance with methods to start, stop, and query container status, and manages container lifecycle.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the container administrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on configuration files found in specified search paths.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Configures logging for container operations, scoped to container.

methods.name: CRunContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializes container context and logging; destructor cleans up container and removes it from admin.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the running container.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks whether the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces the container's process arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Removes leftover containers that may exist from previous runs.
